purpose: Planning ontology for general prompt interpretation. It is not an executable router or a guarantee that any named tool is installed.
execution_policy: A resolver must select only modules explicitly marked implemented after validating inputs and compatibility. Knowledge-only and planned entries can explain, request inputs, or identify a gap but must not emit runnable code.

subanalyses.label: Pedigree and genomic inbreeding

optional_inputs.description: Recorded random seed for a synthetic or resampling workflow.

parameters.description: Biological mating mechanism.
Do not equate cycles with biological generations.
Individuals retained per generation or cycle.
Number of specified time units.
Recorded random seed for a synthetic or resampling workflow.

expected_outputs: ROH segments when phased markers and a definition are supplied
qc_and_guardrails: Do not substitute selfing for cousin mating.
Do not conflate pedigree F, marker homozygosity, and ROH-based F.
Synthetic output is not clinical prediction.

subanalyses.label: Relatedness-aware association calibration

parameters.description: Association adjustments to compare.
Recorded random seed for a synthetic or resampling workflow.

qc_and_guardrails: Do not claim calibration without null or synthetic truth.

subanalyses.label: Population construction

parameters.description: Cross design.
Number of parents.
Required for RIL-like schemes.
Recorded random seed for a synthetic or resampling workflow.

qc_and_guardrails: Check scheme is biologically feasible for organism.
Use a compatible genetic map for map-aware recombination.

subanalyses.label: Trait generation

parameters.description: Outcome distribution must follow the requested phenotype.
Proportion of variance assigned to additive genetic effects.
Required for binomial counts; omit for Bernoulli binary trait.
Recorded random seed for a synthetic or resampling workflow.

qc_and_guardrails: Do not turn “binomial” into binary unless trials equal one.
Check values are valid for selected outcome family.

subanalyses.label: Quantitative-trait GWAS

parameters.description: Association model.
Confounding adjustment.
Significance control.
Quantitative route only.

qc_and_guardrails: Alleles, genomic build, phenotype and covariate IDs must align.
Report failed fits and avoid interpreting association as causation.

subanalyses.label: Binary and case-control GWAS

parameters.description: Binary outcome association model.
Definition of 0/1 phenotype.

qc_and_guardrails: Do not use quantitative linear GWAS for a binary phenotype.
Detect separation and report it.

subanalyses.label: Multitrait, GxE, and longitudinal GWAS

parameters.description: Required grouping terms for repeated observations.

qc_and_guardrails: Define independent units; repeated measurements are not independent rows.

subanalyses.label: Rare-variant and gene-based association
qc_and_guardrails: Variant functional filters must be declared.

subanalyses.label: Linkage QTL mapping

parameters.description: Empirical threshold iterations.

qc_and_guardrails: Do not replace QTL mapping with GWAS.
Genetic map and marker order must be consistent.

subanalyses.label: Bulk count simulation

parameters.description: Independent biological replicates per condition.
Fixed effects and interactions to simulate.
Recorded random seed for a synthetic or resampling workflow.

qc_and_guardrails: Do not require FASTA for count-only simulation.
Technical replicates do not replace biological replicates.

subanalyses.label: Bulk differential expression

parameters.description: Must include condition and known confounders.
Specific comparison to test.

qc_and_guardrails: Raw counts, not TPM/FPKM, are required for standard NB DE models.
Avoid a design where batch is perfectly confounded with condition.

subanalyses.label: Time-course and longitudinal RNA-seq
required_inputs: count matrix or time-course simulation design

parameters.description: Must encode time and condition/time interaction when requested.
Whether the same individuals appear at multiple times.

qc_and_guardrails: Require actual time values and replicate structure.
Repeated samples require a subject-aware model.

subanalyses.label: Isoform and splicing analysis
qc_and_guardrails: Differential exon usage is not ordinary gene-level DE.
Confirm strandness, annotation build, and junction-count provenance.

subanalyses.label: Allele-specific expression
qc_and_guardrails: Require heterozygous, phased sites and mapping-bias handling.

subanalyses.label: RNA-seq power and sample size
required_inputs: pilot count data or explicit mean-dispersion assumptions

parameters.description: Recorded random seed for a synthetic or resampling workflow.

expected_outputs: recommended sample size under stated assumptions
qc_and_guardrails: A power calculation inherits its mean/dispersion assumptions.

subanalyses.label: Bulk cis/trans eQTL

parameters.description: Search for independent cis signals.

qc_and_guardrails: Genotype, expression and covariate sample IDs must match.
State cis window and genotype/reference build.

subanalyses.label: Splicing QTL mapping
qc_and_guardrails: Splicing phenotype construction must be documented before mapping.

subanalyses.label: Single-cell and cell-type eQTL
required_inputs: cell metadata with donor and cell type
qc_and_guardrails: Cells are not independent genetic replicates; donor structure is required.

subanalyses.label: Single-cell simulation

parameters.description: Recorded random seed for a synthetic or resampling workflow.

qc_and_guardrails: Keep donor and cell-level replication distinct.

subanalyses.label: Single-cell processing and DE
qc_and_guardrails: Avoid treating cells from one donor as independent biological replicates.

subanalyses.label: Peak analysis
qc_and_guardrails: ChIP-seq needs target/antibody and appropriate control design.
ATAC and ChIP are not interchangeable assays.

subanalyses.label: Genomic prediction
qc_and_guardrails: Prevent training/test leakage across families and generations.

subanalyses.label: Structure, ancestry, and diversity
qc_and_guardrails: Population labels and genotyping batches can confound ancestry inference.

subanalyses.label: LD analysis
qc_and_guardrails: LD is population, marker-density, and sample-size dependent.

subanalyses.label: Selection and differentiation scans
qc_and_guardrails: Selection scans need an explicit demographic null or cautious interpretation.

families.label: Sequencing simulation, assembly, and variant calling

subanalyses.label: Sequencing read simulation

parameters.description: Recorded random seed for a synthetic or resampling workflow.

qc_and_guardrails: Use a platform-compatible profile and disclose synthetic assumptions.

subanalyses.label: Assembly and assembly QC
qc_and_guardrails: N50 alone is not assembly correctness.
Reference-based and reference-free QC answer different questions.

subanalyses.label: Variant calling and filtering
qc_and_guardrails: Reference build, ploidy, and joint-calling cohort must be explicit.

families.label: Genome annotation, gene function, and ontology

subanalyses.label: Coordinate and functional annotation

parameters.description: Stable ID namespace and assembly.

qc_and_guardrails: Assembly and identifier namespace must match; symbol joins are not safe by default.
GO mapping is not GO enrichment.

subanalyses.label: GxE and linked multi-omics
required_inputs: matched sample IDs across at least two modalities
qc_and_guardrails: Modalities must be matched at the declared unit: sample, donor, line, or cell.
Association across modalities is not mediation or causality.

subanalyses.label: 16S and shotgun metagenomics
qc_and_guardrails: This package has no implemented metagenomics route yet.
Compositional data require method-specific interpretation.
